title: Priority Mask Off-by-One — Current Master Included
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [FAIRNESS] Same master granted twice consecutively; off-by-one in mask
rtl: assign mask = (4'h1 << last_gnt) - 1;  // Excludes 0..last_gnt-1 but includes last_gnt
expected_root_cause: The priority mask expression ((1 << last_gnt) - 1) excludes masters 0 through last_gnt-1 but incorrectly includes last_gnt itself in the grant-eligible set, allowing the same master to be granted twice in consecutive arbitration cycles.
description: The mask is `(1 << last_gnt) - 1`, which excludes masters 0 through last_gnt−1 correctly but includes last_gnt itself, re-granting the same master twice in a row.
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [FAIRNESS] Same master granted twice consecutively; off-by-one in mask
success_log: Mask correctly excludes last_gnt. Each master granted exactly once per round.
